d: An anthropomorphic feline creature with an adult, mature expression and a powerful, muscular build. The head features a thick, layered mane of platinum white and ash grey fur, while the body is covered in a smooth, charcoal grey pelt. The outfit consists of a deep crimson and burnt orange ensemble featuring a structured bodice, a sweeping open-front skirt with gold geometric trim, and charcoal grey leggings. Visible accessories include gold teardrop earrings and a large, golden circular sun-disk held aloft. BODY COLOR: Charcoal grey LEGS: Plantigrade with wide, feline paws.
